A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same FLAIR research and contain complete, readable main text and Appendices A–E. Text comparison and rendered-page inspection support matching the equations, three figures and five tables.

before.justification: V3 reports original FLAIR benchmark outcomes in Tables 1–3 and original pretraining, component-comparison and case-study results in Appendix E, alongside externally sourced baseline scores.

after.justification: V5 retains the original FLAIR evaluations in Tables 1–3 and the pretraining, component-comparison and case-study results in Appendix E.

M1.justification: The vocabulary-weighted latent feedback, Global-aware Expert, timing predictor, three-loss objective and staged training/inference procedure remain unchanged in Sections 4–5. Probability-subscript edits do not change the method.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same speech-continuation, instruction-following QA and ASR-QA training coverage, eight QA benchmarks, Impatient, and Full-Duplex-Bench's CANDOR and interruption scenarios. Appendix C retains the same data coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within Tables 1–3 and Appendix E. SALMONN-omni was already evaluated in v3; its expanded discussion is not a new baseline. ORISE's added citation year likewise leaves the comparison unchanged.

E3.justification: The evaluation metrics, Whisper-large-v3 transcription, GPT judging, model configurations and training settings are retained. Noise augmentation and the 300-instance Llama Questions sampling for t-SNE also remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Both retain the latent-reasoning comparison, Figure 3 visualization, and Appendix E analyses of pretraining, encoder size, expert architecture and speech synthesis, including the Table 5 response case study.

E5.justification: Point-estimate reporting and Appendix E's MOS and small-scale A/B-test descriptions are unchanged. Neither version adds repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals or formal significance tests.

E6.justification: Tables 1–5, Figure 3 and Appendix E retain the same numerical and qualitative results. For example, FLAIR with latent reasoning remains at 78.0% on Llama Questions and 56.2% on MMSU, with 100% barge-in success on Impatient.

T1.justification: Equations 4–5 and 14–16 standardize P versus P_theta notation. V3 already describes the conditional prior as learned; v5 makes its parameter subscript explicit. The assumptions, factorizations, ELBO bounds and derivations are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution bullets and conclusion retain the same novelty and performance claims: causal think-while-listening, teacher-forced latent learning without reasoning annotations, improved responses and no additional inference overhead.

C2.justification: Section 2 drops the inference that explicit streaming-CoT methods' data-construction or causality problems consequently imply limited gains or restricted applicability. This locally softens the interpretation of prior methods; Section 7's comparison exclusions and FLAIR's own result explanations and Appendix E tradeoffs remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Appendices C–D retain the same data-generation recipes, model specifications, 64 A800 GPU configuration, hyperparameters and resource links. No implementation or resource-access information is added or removed.

R1.justification: Section 2 adds explicit discussion of end-to-end full-duplex training and the already-cited SALMONN-omni's capabilities. References to He et al. (2019), Yamamoto et al. (2025), Skerry-Ryan et al. (2018) and Khouzaimi et al. (2016) are removed. This is a localized revision of research positioning.

P1.justification: Localized edits include the related-work rewrite, new funding acknowledgements, proceedings footer, notation cleanup and bibliographic capitalization/year corrections. Section order remains stable. The Saunshi citation changes from an abbreviated citation to an awkward full-author string.

P2.justification: Figure 2 receives small sizing and spacing adjustments while retaining its components and caption. Front matter, references and some equations reflow locally. All three figures and five tables remain, without substantial redesign.

improvement.justification: V5 modestly improves contextual completeness by discussing existing end-to-end systems, particularly SALMONN-omni, and softening a broad criticism of explicit reasoning approaches in Section 2. More consistent probability notation also improves clarity. These limited benefits outweigh the awkward expanded Saunshi citation; the methods, empirical evidence and substantive appendix content remain unchanged.
